provenance.fetched_by: exp_dev (Claude Sonnet 5), interactive Bash with live internet access
provenance.sample_method: sha256('SEED42_LEXICAL_TAIL::' + entity_id) sorted ascending, take first 500
provenance.sample_population_filter: prefix in {CN,WN,FN} (lexical/concept entity types) AND degree(support) <= 1 in relations.jsonl
provenance.excluded_non_lexical_tail_note: entities with support<=1 whose id did not match ^(CN|WN|FN)_ (mostly provenance/admin refs e.g. 'RF/research_drill_...', EXP_/CAP_/RETRIEVAL_ prefixes) -- these are not groundable concept nouns, excluded from sampling population per fairness discipline (disclosed, not silently dropped)
provenance.join_method: exact enwiki-sitelink-title lookup via Wikidata API action=wbgetentities&sites=enwiki&titles=<title>&props=claims -- NO fuzzy search, NO wbsearchentities substring matching. Title normalization: strip CN_/WN_/FN_ prefix; for WN_ additionally strip trailing WordNet sense suffix (regex \.[a-z]\.\d+$); replace underscores with spaces; capitalize first character only (standard enwiki title casing). A returned 'missing' flag = definitive miss (no fuzzy fallback attempted).
provenance.hit_definition: entity resolves to a live Wikidata QID via exact enwiki title AND that QID has >=1 claim whose mainsnak.datatype == 'quantity' (a genuine numeric-literal-typed property, e.g. P2067 mass, P2046 area, P1082 population -- NOT any claim, NOT identifier-typed claims)
provenance.request_pattern: one wbgetentities call per entity (unambiguous 1:1 mapping; an earlier batched-multi-title approach was abandoned after it was found the API omits the queried 'title' field on HITS, making reverse entity-attribution ambiguous)
